operations.title: S2 Infrastructure Decisions: Metadata, Archive, and Overlap Prevention
operations.content: Infrastructure consolidation decisions enabling robust community encoding. S2 community decoder overlap check (id:f62b7a12) prevents duplicates via 60% threshold in community_contract.py, filtering 43 clusters in first run and simulating zero self-overlap at 30% for remaining 90 communities. Unified _store_node_metadata() (id:c9f0d394) extracted from remember() and revise() paths, routing by contract: STRUCTURAL fields skipped, situation text stored in node_enrichments with deferred vector backfill, promoted metadata to MetadataDAL, emergent/unknown fields preserved. Fixed critical loss: situation was silently dropped in both paths, community metadata was dropped since April 13 when _store_node_metadata was removed. Unified archive_node() (id:0fd3f6e1) is canonical archive function with edge cleanup, vector cleanup, FTS5 removal, and _sys_ audit metadata. _sys_ prefix convention (id:140a9fa0) filters system/infrastructure metadata from LLM rendering via contract layer (not DAL) for transparency and debuggability. S2CE per-type quotas (id:4c103b3c) ensure balanced proposal processing: merge=5, add_to_existing=30, health_update=5, new_community=15, drift=5, max_actionable=60 per run. Previous flat ordering monopolized all 60 slots with add_to_existing (456 proposals), starving new_community. Minified proposal format (id:ea7bd0b2) reduced batch token consumption 50K→3.7K via dropping richly-rendered hubs, sample edges, transition details, replacing all-community listing with recall-based 15 communities, reducing run time from 21 to 8 minutes. Dashboard gaps (id:4eb86b29): S2 Healer missing from Encoding feed (no /api/enrichment-runs endpoint), consolidation Show Prompt broken (reads non-existent /tmp file), community has no Show Prompt button.

operations.title: Recall Pipeline Precision Feedback Loop: Mark Used Detection and Hook Communication
operations.content: Three blocking issues preventing precision loop closure. Recall pipeline (id:ee205f63) spans query vocab expansion, embedding via Snowflake 768d, intent classification, cosine scan all nodes, blended scoring (0.8 emb + 0.1 kw), type/critical/confidence multipliers, top-K hydration, Hebbian strengthening, recall_log write. Pipeline corruption (id:1633932e): 15 bare except:pass blocks across daemon_hooks.hook_recall (8), hook_post_response (3), brain_recall (3), brain_engineering (1) hide all failures via silent error suppression, preventing consciousness signals. mark_recall_used() missing (id:bf618356) means recall_log.used_count stays 0, gating off Hebbian signal (useful>0 never true), precision measurement impossible. Two design uncertainties blocking implementation: How should mark_recall_used determine which nodes Claude actually used (id:8a8f9bbc) — options are text matching (crude), embedding similarity (slow), explicit Claude marking (unreliable), or hybrid. How to pass _recall_log_id from pre-response hook to post-response hook (id:8166f7d0) — options are brain.set_config (simple), file-based (brittle), harness args (unknown if supported). Consolidated insight: except:pass blocks + missing mark_recall_used + communication design = precision loop dead. Hook integration is the fundamental blocker.

operations.title: S2 Community Detection Infrastructure: Cold Start Prevention and State-Based Incremental
operations.content: Four infrastructure fixes closing S2 community detection brittleness. S2 _last_run_timestamp SQL bug (id:5b8e39e9) — query lacked unit name filtering and date sorting, causing incorrect reference point and unintended cold starts. Success check definition (id:10db439b) — initially treated 0-action delta traces as failures (wrong). Tom's correction: 0 actions = valid complete run finding nothing new. Missing delta trace = incomplete run = signal of failure. State-based detection (id:dd301b34) replaces trace archaeology: find nodes without community_member edges, process those, done. Crash-safe (if encoder stops mid-batch, next run finds exact remaining unplaced nodes), no duplicates from trace checkpoints, no timestamp guessing. 76 duplicate communities incident (id:c46084ff) on April 15 triggered by _last_run_timestamp bug creating cold start, overlapping with existing 112 communities. Archived the 76 April 15 batch. Type guard fix (id:ce8d9aef) for brain_batch malformed operation crashes (strings instead of dicts from LLM) — now logs and continues instead of aborting entire batch. Pattern: defensive validation of LLM-generated operations prevents one malformed item from killing batch processing.
operations.situation: When implementing incremental S2 processing, debugging cold start regressions, or making systems crash-safe from mid-batch failures

operations.title: Data Integrity and Escalation: Junk Detection and Graph-Safe Operations
operations.content: Two core principles protecting data quality. When you see junk in recall results, escalate immediately (id:6e20dcfe) — TEST NODE DELETE ME appeared in top results inflating precision to 0.99 across board. Anchor saw it and reported as finding instead of escalating immediately for deletion. Job is to catch corruption and fix/escalate, not observe passively. Same applies to garbled vocab nodes, orphaned test data, duplicates. Bad data corrupts downstream decisions. Graph-safe deletion (id:e7074f47) preserves paths through deleted nodes via connection rewiring rather than cascading orphans. Two complementary principles: (1) Proactive escalation on bad data, (2) Careful deletion mechanics preserving graph integrity.
operations.situation: When cleaning corrupted data from the brain or implementing safe node deletion that maintains graph structure
operations.keywords: junk data escalation graph-safe deletion orphaned nodes integrity
